review:
BGaming's answer to Gates of Olympus, made with Perfect Position: a pay-anywhere grid with Zeus watching every spin and a clear, transparent multiplier system.

There are four buy options, including a Bonus with 2x to 1,000x multipliers and a Super Bonus with 10x to 1,000x. Very high volatility, 15,000x max and 96.03% RTP. Free spins about once every 372 spins.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus is rare (about 1 in 372 spins on average)
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
